proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Minus six on a January morning and the spring let go with the minivan inside. They were out by nine, replaced both springs and checked the opener too. Kids made it to school late, not absent.
reviews.name: Megan T.

reviews.text: The May hail took out the whole street. Kristin's crew told me two of my panels could be swapped and the rest was fine. My neighbor got a full door pitched by someone else.
reviews.name: Doug R.

reviews.text: Door froze to the slab after an ice storm and the opener kept straining. They freed it, put on a new bottom rubber and told me to stop hitting the button when it sticks. Fair.
reviews.name: Alicia F.

reviews.text: We use the garage as a woodshop all winter. Insulated door plus new weatherstripping and the space heater finally keeps up.
reviews.name: Pete N.

reviews.text: Booked the fall tune-up in October. They found a frayed cable I would never have noticed, and the door has run clean through two snowstorms since.
reviews.name: Shonda W.

reviews.text: Power went out in a spring storm and we could not get the car out. Called, they talked me through the release cord safely, and the new opener has a battery now.
reviews.name: Carlos V.

proof.guarantee: Springs we install are covered for 5 years, including the cold-snap breaks winter is known for.
